name: SingularityApp
description_en:
SingularityApp combines personal tasks, recurring commitments, habits, notes and focus timers across desktop, mobile and Web clients. Its planning choices include recurrence templates, project sharing and Google Calendar viewing or two-way synchronization. These have different plan and permission conditions.

The free Basic tier is single-device; paid tiers add sync and collaboration. Built-in AI and external MCP are separate access paths. This documentation review focuses on those boundaries, platform-specific recovery and subscription conditions. Shared-project marketing and the terms’ personal/noncommercial license wording remain an unresolved scope issue for business use.
description_zh:
SingularityApp 在桌面、移动及 Web 客户端组合个人任务、重复安排、习惯、笔记和专注计时。规划能力包括重复模板、项目共享，以及 Google Calendar 查看或双向同步；各自有不同方案及权限条件。

免费 Basic 限单设备，付费层增加同步及协作。内置 AI 与外部 MCP 是独立访问路径。本次文档研究聚焦这些边界、各平台恢复方式及订阅条件。共享项目营销与条款的个人／非商业许可措辞，对业务使用范围仍存在未解决问题。

core_features.explanation_en: Template changes and occurrence changes affect different tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 修改模板与修改实例影响不同任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Task editing is shared, while project administration remains owner-controlled.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可共同编辑任务，项目管理仍由所有者控制。

core_features.explanation_en: View is read-only; Sync converts events/tasks in both directions.
core_features.explanation_zh: View 只读；Sync 双向转换事件与任务。

en: Plan a recurring personal review, then test one shared project and an isolated calendar before expanding access.
zh: 规划重复个人复核，再测试一个共享项目及隔离日历，然后扩大访问范围。

items.zh: Web 备份需经桌面客户端恢复，不支持直接在 Web 恢复。

sections.title_en: A repeated task has a template and occurrences
sections.title_zh: 重复任务包含模板和实例
sections.en:
For a hypothetical weekly review, distinguish changing one occurrence from changing the recurring template. The documentation says template edits update future unmodified incomplete occurrences; manually changed occurrences are preserved. An alternative creates the next task only after completing the previous one, with the interval counted from completion.

Choose which commitment is intended: a fixed review day or a recovery interval after the last completion. Inspect a late completion and a manually moved occurrence before relying on it. Deleting a template together with its tasks also removes existing future occurrences. These semantics were read, not exercised.
sections.zh:
以假设每周复核为例，需区分修改单个实例与修改重复模板。文档称模板修改会更新未来未人工修改、未完成的实例；人工改过的实例保留。另一选项只在完成上个任务后创建下个任务，并从完成时点计算间隔。

应先确定承诺是固定复核日，还是上次完成后的间隔。依赖此功能前，检查一次延迟完成及一个人工移动实例。连同任务删除模板也会删除已存在的未来实例。本次读取了这些规则，没有实际操作。

sections.title_en: Shared tasks do not share every surrounding item
sections.title_zh: 共享任务不等于共享周边全部内容
sections.en:
Participants may edit tasks and section content, but project settings, invitations and section creation/deletion remain owner controls. Tags are personal; attachments belong to the owner and are inaccessible to participants. Subprojects created by the owner do not automatically become visible. Shared task encryption is unsupported.

For a proposed two-person review, verify that each person can open the needed reference material through its own authorized location. Do not build a handoff around an attachment the other participant cannot access. Confirm the project owner and recovery contact before using sharing for an ongoing commitment.
sections.zh:
参与者可编辑任务及分区内容，但项目设置、邀请及创建／删除分区仍由所有者控制。标签为个人所有；附件属于所有者，参与者无法访问。所有者创建的子项目不会自动可见，共享任务不支持加密。

假设两人共同复核，应确认双方可通过各自获授权的位置打开所需参考材料。不要把交接建立在另一人无法访问的附件上。持续协作前，确认项目所有者及恢复联系人。

sections.title_en: Choose the write scope before enabling Calendar sync
sections.title_zh: 启用日历同步前确定写入范围
sections.en:
View displays Google events without editing them in SingularityApp. Sync is two-way between events and tasks. Mapping can target one project or all projects, and changing that mapping after saving requires disabling and reconnecting. Completion can retain, remove or mark the calendar event.

Pilot a separate calendar and explicitly inspect untimed-task behavior. If authorization expires, documented synchronization stops until the same Google account is reauthorized. General two-way wording does not settle every simultaneous-edit or deletion conflict; those were not tested.
sections.zh:
View 显示 Google 事件，但不能在 SingularityApp 编辑；Sync 在事件与任务间双向同步。映射可选一个项目或全部项目，保存后改变映射需停用并重新连接。任务完成时可保留、移除或标记日历事件。

应先用独立日历试点，并明确检查无时间任务的处理。文档称授权过期后会停止同步，直至重新授权同一 Google 账户。通用双向表述不能解决所有同时编辑或删除冲突，本次未实测。

sections.title_en: A downloaded backup needs a usable restore path
sections.title_zh: 下载备份还需要可用恢复路径
sections.en:
Desktop daily backups keep ten copies and cannot be disabled. Android’s default app-folder copies disappear on uninstall; its Documents option survives but needs file permission. Web cannot restore directly: download a backup and restore through a desktop client, then cloud synchronization. Mobile restoration pauses sync until signing in again.

Retain a recoverable open backup in an authorized location and rehearse restoration with disposable data. The documentation’s obfuscated diagnostic backup is a support artifact, not the same recovery file. No restore or deletion was performed.
sections.zh:
桌面每日备份保留十份且不能关闭。Android 默认应用目录的副本会随卸载删除；Documents 选项可保留，但需要文件权限。Web 无法直接恢复：需下载备份，经桌面客户端恢复后再云同步。移动端恢复后会暂停同步，直至重新登录。

应在获授权位置保留可恢复的开放备份，并用可丢弃数据演练恢复。文档所称混淆诊断备份供支持使用，与恢复文件不同。本次没有恢复或删除数据。

sections.title_en: Built-in agents and MCP authorize different access
sections.title_zh: 内置 Agent 与 MCP 授予不同访问
sections.en:
The built-in assistant is documented as a Web/desktop beta for Elite or its trial, using provider API keys supplied by the user. Advice and Agent modes differ: Agent can change tasks, projects and habits. Account context may go to external model providers and provider usage can incur charges.

External MCP is separately documented for Pro/Elite and can read account context and perform supported writes through a connected client. A paid task subscription alone does not establish model credits or safe autonomous changes. Inspect the client’s requested permissions and review proposed changes using disposable records; no key, model or MCP client was connected here.
sections.zh:
文档中的内置助手是面向 Elite 或其试用的 Web／桌面 beta，由用户提供模型服务商 API key。建议与 Agent 模式不同，Agent 可修改任务、项目及习惯。账户上下文可能发送给外部模型方，使用模型也可能另行收费。

外部 MCP 另行面向 Pro／Elite，通过连接的客户端读取账户上下文并执行支持的写入。付费任务订阅本身不证明包含模型额度或可放心自动修改。应检查客户端请求的权限，并用可丢弃记录复核拟议修改；本次没有连接 key、模型或 MCP 客户端。

sections.title_en: Basic limits, paid sync and use permission are separate
sections.title_zh: 基础限制、付费同步及使用许可分别核对
sections.en:
Basic is single-device with ten projects, five sections per project and three habits. Pro adds synchronization and sharing with up to five project members; Elite lists project Kanban and up to ten. Displayed annual equivalents are $3.33/month for Pro and $4.17 for Elite; monthly billing shows $3.99 and $4.99. Rounded equivalents do not establish exact annual checkout totals.

The terms specify USD before taxes and a personal/noncommercial grant, which needs clarification for business use despite shared-project marketing. Trial ends after fourteen days and falls back to free. Website first-payment refunds have a thirty-day window; renewal/upgrade and store rules differ. For lapsed paid plans, the terms reserve deletion after more than three months without payment. Keep recoverable data before lapse; this is not a blanket deletion claim about always-free accounts.
sections.zh:
Basic 限单设备、十个项目、每项目五个分区及三个习惯。Pro 增加同步，项目最多五名成员；Elite 列出项目看板及最多十名成员。Pro、Elite 年付折合每月分别 $3.33、$4.17，月付分别 $3.99、$4.99。四舍五入折合值不能确立准确年付结账总额。

条款指定税前美元及个人／非商业授权；即使营销提供共享项目，业务使用仍需澄清。十四天试用后转免费。网站首次付款有三十天退款窗口；续费／升级及商店规则不同。付费方案失效后，条款保留超过三个月未付款时删除的权利。失效前应保留可恢复数据；这不是对始终免费账户一概删除的断言。

research_gaps.en: No client installation, login, recurrence, participant sharing, file access, Calendar grant, backup/restore, payment/refund, AI or MCP operation tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试安装、登录、重复、参与者共享、文件访问、日历授权、备份／恢复、付款／退款、AI 或 MCP 操作。

research_gaps.en: Business-use permission versus personal/noncommercial terms, managed AI model availability/prices versus own-key beta, exact annual checkout/tax/store rates and full client parity remain unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: 业务使用与个人／非商业条款范围、托管模型可用性／价格与自备 key beta 的关系、准确年付结账／税／商店费率及完整客户端一致性仍未解决。

research_gaps.en: Concurrent edits, deletion propagation, missed notifications, independent recovery completeness, source redistribution rights and full current interface languages not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 并发修改、删除传播、遗漏通知、独立恢复完整性、源码再分发权利及当前完整界面语言未核实。
